title: No certificate date on the form; a compliance service is orange
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. A schedule with a compliance service. Seed it: New schedule; Add service "CVIP", turn on "Is this a compliance inspection?", Type "CVIP", Term 12 months; save the service and the schedule.
  4. ↳ Open Customers, open a test customer (e.g. "Aacrest Works"), open its Assets tab and open an asset (e.g. unit 402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia).
  5. ↳ Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes) and click Enroll in Schedule.
  6. ↳ Pick the schedule (e.g. "Highway Tractor PM"), leave the last service dates blank unless the case says otherwise, and click Enroll.
  7. ↳ Do not add any certificate record for the asset.
custom_steps:
1. Open the CVIP service form again and look for any certificate date field.
  2. On the enrolled asset's Maintenance tab read the CVIP row: its colour and what it says.
  3. Open the worklist (Customers > Maintenance reminders) with no tile active and look for the CVIP row; read the tile counts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The compliance service form has no certificate date field (certificate dates are kept on the asset's record).
  • The CVIP row reads "No record" and shows no due badge; compliance styling is orange, never red.
  • The record-less CVIP row is not counted in any tile.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10560 (S3, Add a compliance inspection service), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S3 (What it does not ask for; How it behaves afterwards); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R9: “No certificate date will appear on this form. Certificate dates belong to the record on the asset”
  • S3-N2: “A compliance service with no matching record on the asset cannot come due, reads No record”
  • S3-R10: “A compliance service will be orange, never red”
  • S3-N2: “is excluded from every count”
